content.short: Altr digitizes luxury collectibles on the blockchain and enables fractional ownership and collateralized borrowing.
content.description: Altr enables the digitization and liquidity of physical assets on the blockchain. Collectors can acquire rare items in full or as fractional ownership using USDT and can also convert existing collections into digital assets to back liquidity when borrowing, without selling. Each item is represented by a digital proof of ownership as an NFT that can be held, traded, collateralized, or redeemed for the physical asset at any time. To ensure credibility, Altr collaborates with Oracles, seasoned professionals in luxury collectibles who offer appraisals, valuations, and secure storage.
content.meta: Altr helps digitize and provide liquidity for physical assets on the blockchain. Discover Altr and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
